title: The Davido Dozen: 12 ‘Oriade’ Tracks Stack U.S. Afrobeats Songs Chart
summary: Among Davido’s dozen entries this week is his 12th top 10 on the 4-year-old list.
contentText:
Davido lands 12 songs from his Oriadé album on the Billboard U.S. Afrobeats Songs chart, collecting his 12th top 10 in the process. The tracks flood the chart dated Aug. 15, pushing the Nigerian-American superstar to 56 career entries since the chart launched in April 2022.

“B4 B4,” a collaboration with Mayorkun and FOLA, leads Davido’s new appearances with its No. 6 entrance. The song traces its start almost entirely to 626,000 chart-eligible, official streams in the United States for the July 31-Aug. 6 tracking week, according to Luminate. For Mayorkun, “B4 B4” marks his first top 10 in four appearances on U.S. Afrobeats Songs; FOLA adds an eighth to his ledger, of 25 total entries.

As mentioned, Davido claims a 12th top 10 with “B4 B4.” Here’s a recap of his collection:

Song Title, Artist (if other than Davido), Peak Position, Peak Date
“Stand Strong,” feat. Sunday Service Choir; No. 9, May 28, 2022
“Over Dem,” No. 10, April 15, 2023
“Unavailable,” feat. Musa Keys, No. 3, Aug. 26, 2023
“Awuke,” with YG Marley; No. 9, Nov. 16, 2024
“Funds,” feat. ODUMODUBLVCK & Chike; No. 5, Dec. 21, 2024
“Be There Still,” No. 7, March 29, 2025
“Titanium,” feat. Chris Brown; No. 6, May 3, 2025
“Offa Me,” feat. Victoria Monét; No. 5, May 3, 2025
“With You,” feat. Omah Lay; No. 5, May 17, 2025
“I Know Who I Be,” with JAZZWRLD & GL_Ceejay; No. 6, July 11, 2026
“Gimme Dat Thing,” with No11; Aug. 1, 2026
“B4 B%,” with Mayorkun & FOLA; No. 6 (to date), Aug. 15, 2026

Oriadé , released on July 31 through DaVido/RCA Records, registered 5,000 equivalent album units for the tracking week. It debuts at No. 8 on the World Albums chart, giving the performer his sixth consecutive top 10 visit. He first entered the ranking with the EP Son of Mercy , which peaked at No. 4 in 2016, and followed with A Good Time (No. 6, 2019); A Better Time (No. 4, 2020); Timeless (No. 2, 2023) and 5ive (No. 2, 2025).

To review Oriadé ’s impact, here’s a review of its placements on U.S. Afrobeats Songs. All are debuts, except “I Know Who I Be,” which peaked at No. 6 and climbs 14-13 this week, while “Gimme Dat Ting,” a No. 7 hit, slips 17-18.
